hooks.command: $output = & python regression/verify_against_baseline.py --quick 2>&1 | Out-String; $status = if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }; $tail = ($output -split "`r?`n" | Select-Object -Last 15) -join "`n"; $msg = "[regression] verify --quick: $status`n$tail"; @{ systemMessage = $msg } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0
